summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Samuel Oboh, born in Lagos, Nigeria. It describes his education: a B.Sc in architecture from Bendel State University (now Ambrose Alli University), a Master of Science in architecture from Ahmadu Bello University in Zaria, and a Master of Arts from the University of Alberta, where he received the Herbert Marshall McLuhan Graduate Student Award.
one_line: Samuel Oboh is a Nigerian-born architect and scholar whose education spans Nigerian universities and the University of Alberta.
key_facts: Samuel Oboh was born in Lagos, Nigeria.
Samuel Oboh studied architecture at Bendel State University for his bachelor's degree (B.Sc).
Bendel State University is now known as Ambrose Alli University.
Samuel Oboh earned a Master of Science degree in architecture from Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria, Nigeria.
Samuel Oboh graduated from the University of Alberta with a Master of Arts.
Samuel Oboh was a recipient of the Herbert Marshall McLuhan Graduate Student Award while at the University of Alberta.
